import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def power(a, b):
    ans = 1
    while b > 0:
        if b & 1:
            ans = (ans * a) % MOD
        a = (a * a) % MOD
        b >>= 1
    return ans

data = input().split()
n = int(data[0])
p = []
index = 1
inv_100 = power(100, MOD - 2)

for _ in range(n):
    row = []
    for _ in range(n):
        j = int(data[index])
        index += 1
        j = (j * inv_100) % MOD
        row.append(j)
    p.append(row)

from collections import defaultdict

id_list = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
subsets = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]

for sz in range(n + 1):
    id_list[sz] = [0] * (1 << n)
    for s in range(1 << n):
        if bin(s).count('1') == sz:
            id_list[sz][s] = len(subsets[sz])
            subsets[sz].append(s)

families = [defaultdict(int) for _ in range(n + 1)]
families[0][1] = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for s in range(1 << n):
        pr = 1
        for j in range(n):
            if (s >> j) & 1:
                pr = (pr * p[i - 1][j]) % MOD
            else:
                pr = (pr * (1 + MOD - p[i - 1][j])) % MOD
        for f, _p in families[i - 1].items():
            mask = 0
            for t in subsets[i]:
                for j in range(n):
                    if ((t >> j) & 1) and ((s >> j) & 1) and ((f >> id_list[i - 1][t ^ (1 << j)]) & 1):
                        mask |= 1 << id_list[i][t]
                        break
            families[i][mask] = (families[i][mask] + _p * pr) % MOD

print(families[n][1])
